data.title: Add in-memory service
data.description: The Fleece API should provide a synchronised .NET service that can be used to load a set of Fleece issues from JSONL files and keep them in memory, keeping the JSONL file up to date and watching for external changes on the JSONL files. See 'https://github.com/nick-boey/Homespun/tree/main/src/Homespun/Features/Fleece/Services' for an implementation of this to be largely copied in and improved.
